properties.statement: Answered "how much of this system is untested?" entirely outside the design: shell commands to count test functions, source files and lines, then installed a coverage tool and ran it for line/region/function percentages per module. The design holds 312 Verification nodes and a computed delivery line, and none of it could answer the question the owner actually asked — nor can it hold the answer now that it exists, since a coverage figure has no home beyond free-text prose on a TemporalFact. The gap is two-sided: nothing reads a coverage measurement in, and nothing reports its absence.
